scope: Laredo and border (Webb, Maverick, Val Verde, Zapata counties): food, housing, utilities, cash_assistance, transportation (plus related local providers)

records.name: South Texas Food Bank
records.description_en: The food bank gives out free food through partner pantries and its own programs. Programs include emergency food, food for seniors, kids' meals, and mobile pantries.
records.description_es: El banco de comida da comida gratis por medio de despensas asociadas y sus propios programas. Hay comida de emergencia, comida para personas mayores, comidas para niños y despensas móviles.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For people who need food in Webb, Zapata, Val Verde, Maverick and other nearby South Texas counties. Rules differ by program and location.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Para personas que necesitan comida en los condados de Webb, Zapata, Val Verde, Maverick y otros condados cercanos del sur de Texas. Las reglas cambian según el programa y el lugar.
records.how_to_apply: Call the food bank or visit a partner pantry near you. Some programs ask you to register first.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llame al banco de comida o vaya a una despensa asociada cerca de usted. Algunos programas le piden registrarse primero.
records.hours: Mon-Thu 8:00 AM - 4:30 PM; Fri 8:00 AM - 12:45 PM
records.notes: Also serves Jim Hogg, Kinney, Dimmit and Starr counties. The site says some programs may not be available in all counties; call to ask. For after-hours emergencies it refers people to 2-1-1. Programs supervisor: ext. 120.

records.name: Mobile Food Pantry
records.description_en: A truck brings free food to neighborhoods. Each family can get one bag of produce a month.
records.description_es: Un camión lleva comida gratis a los vecindarios. Cada familia puede recibir una bolsa de frutas y verduras al mes.
records.eligibility_summary_en: Open to residents of the food bank's counties, including Webb, Zapata, Val Verde and Maverick. Some stops are only for people who live in that area; community-wide stops are open to everyone.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Para residentes de los condados que atiende el banco de comida, como Webb, Zapata, Val Verde y Maverick. Algunas paradas son solo para quienes viven en esa zona; las paradas comunitarias están abiertas a todos.
documents_needed: Photo ID to register (not required at community-wide distributions)
records.how_to_apply: Call the Mobile Food Pantry Coordinator to find the next distribution. Bring a photo ID the first time to get a barcode card for future visits.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llame a la coordinadora de la Despensa Móvil para saber cuándo es la próxima entrega. La primera vez, traiga una identificación con foto para recibir una tarjeta con código de barras para las siguientes visitas.
records.notes: Ask for ext. 119 (Mobile Food Pantry Coordinator). Limit of once a month. Schedules can change.

records.name: Commodity Supplemental Food Program (CSFP) - Senior Boxes
records.description_en: Seniors can get a free box of food each month.
records.description_es: Las personas mayores pueden recibir una caja de comida gratis cada mes.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For seniors over 60 in the food bank's service area. Income rules may apply; call to check.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Para personas mayores de 60 años en el área que atiende el banco de comida. Puede haber límites de ingresos; llame para preguntar.
records.how_to_apply: Call the South Texas Food Bank to sign up.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llame al South Texas Food Bank para inscribirse.
records.notes: The home page describes CSFP as monthly food for seniors over 60. Details like income limits and documents were not listed; confirm by phone. Not every program is offered in every county.

records.name: Bethany House of Laredo
records.description_en: A nonprofit that feeds hungry people and helps people who are homeless. It has served Laredo since 1982.
records.description_es: Una organización sin fines de lucro que da de comer a personas con hambre y ayuda a personas sin hogar. Ayuda en Laredo desde 1982.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For people who are homeless, at risk of homelessness, or hungry in Laredo.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Para personas sin hogar, en riesgo de perder su hogar, o con hambre en Laredo.
records.how_to_apply: Call or visit the office during business hours to ask about meals and shelter help.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llame o visite la oficina en horario de trabajo para preguntar por comidas y ayuda con albergue.
records.notes: Website is under construction; meal times and shelter program details were not listed. Call to confirm current services. Email: info@bethanyhouseoflaredo.org.

records.name: Mission: Border Hope
records.description_en: Offers a food pantry, free clothing, baby supplies, housing stability help and emergency support to families in Eagle Pass.
records.description_es: Ofrece despensa de comida, ropa gratis, artículos para bebé, ayuda para mantener su vivienda y apoyo de emergencia para familias en Eagle Pass.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For families in need in Eagle Pass and Maverick County.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Para familias que necesitan ayuda en Eagle Pass y el condado de Maverick.
records.how_to_apply: Call or visit the office in Eagle Pass to ask about help.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llame o visite la oficina en Eagle Pass para pedir ayuda.
records.notes: Programs: Food Pantry, Housing Stability Program, Free Clothing, Baby Hope (diapers/baby supplies), Digital Empowerment, Emergency Support. Hours and eligibility not posted; call first. Email: contact@missionborderhope.org.

records.name: The Salvation Army Laredo Corps
records.description_en: The Salvation Army in Laredo offers financial assistance and other help to people in need.
records.description_es: El Ejército de Salvación en Laredo ofrece ayuda económica y otros apoyos a personas que lo necesitan.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For people in need in Laredo. Call to learn what help is available now.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Para personas con necesidad en Laredo. Llame para saber qué ayuda hay ahora.
records.how_to_apply: Call the Laredo Corps office to ask about financial assistance.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llame a la oficina del Ejército de Salvación en Laredo para preguntar por ayuda económica.
records.notes: Official page lists financial assistance as a service but gives no details on shelter, meals, or rent/utility help. National line 1-800-SAL-ARMY. Confirm by phone.

records.name: Comprehensive Energy Assistance Program (CEAP)
records.organization: South Texas Development Council (STDC) - Community Services
records.description_en: Helps low-income households pay electric and gas bills. It can also help repair heating or cooling units and teach ways to save energy.
records.description_es: Ayuda a hogares de bajos ingresos a pagar la luz y el gas. También puede ayudar a reparar el aire acondicionado o la calefacción y enseñar formas de ahorrar energía.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For low-income households in Webb and Zapata counties. Priority goes to homes with a child age 5 or younger, a person with a disability, or an older adult.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Para hogares de bajos ingresos en los condados de Webb y Zapata. Tienen prioridad los hogares con un niño de 5 años o menos, una persona con discapacidad o una persona mayor.

eligibility_rules.residency_required: Webb, Zapata, Jim Hogg or Starr County resident

records.how_to_apply: Call STDC Community Services or apply through their online portal linked from the Community Services page.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llame a Servicios Comunitarios de STDC o haga su solicitud en el portal en línea que aparece en la página de Servicios Comunitarios.
records.notes: Online applications go through the CAPTAIN Public Intake Portal (pip.capsystems.com), linked from the STDC Community Services page. Page text still says the '2024 CEAP program' is accepting applications; call to confirm the current program year is open. Email: communityaction@stdc.cog.tx.us. STDC CEAP also serves Jim Hogg and Starr counties. Maverick and Val Verde CEAP provider not confirmed.

records.name: Area Agency on Aging - South Texas
records.description_en: Helps adults 60 and older with meals at centers or at home, rides, caregiver support, and legal and benefits counseling.
records.description_es: Ayuda a adultos de 60 años o más con comidas en centros o en casa, transporte, apoyo para cuidadores, y consejos legales y sobre beneficios.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For people age 60 and older in Webb and Zapata counties. Some Medicare benefits counseling is also for people under 60 on Medicare.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Para personas de 60 años o más en los condados de Webb y Zapata. Algunos consejos sobre Medicare también son para personas menores de 60 que tienen Medicare.
records.how_to_apply: Call STDC and ask for the Area Agency on Aging.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llame a STDC y pida hablar con la Agencia del Área para Personas Mayores (Area Agency on Aging).
records.notes: Also serves Jim Hogg and Starr counties. Services: congregate and home-delivered meals, care coordination, caregiver respite, ombudsman, transportation, legal assistance and benefits counseling.

records.name: South Texas Aging and Disability Resource Center (ADRC)
records.description_en: A one-stop place for older adults and people with disabilities to learn about long-term care, housing help, veterans help and other services.
records.description_es: Un solo lugar donde personas mayores y personas con discapacidad pueden informarse sobre cuidado a largo plazo, ayuda con vivienda, ayuda para veteranos y otros servicios.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For older adults, people with disabilities, and their caregivers.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Para personas mayores, personas con discapacidad y quienes las cuidan.
records.how_to_apply: Call the ADRC toll-free line for information and referral.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llame gratis a la línea del ADRC para recibir información y referencias.
records.notes: Phone is 1-855-YES-ADRC. Linked from STDC (serves Webb, Zapata, Jim Hogg, Starr); the ADRC page itself did not list counties. Offers information and referral, veterans help, housing support and Money Follows the Person (MFP) help.

records.name: Public Housing - Laredo Housing Authority
records.organization: Housing Authority of the City of Laredo
records.description_en: Low-cost apartments owned and run by the Laredo Housing Authority at 8 locations in Laredo.
records.description_es: Apartamentos de bajo costo que son de la Autoridad de Vivienda de Laredo, en 8 lugares de Laredo.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For low-income families, seniors and people with disabilities who need affordable housing in Laredo.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Para familias de bajos ingresos, personas mayores y personas con discapacidad que necesitan vivienda económica en Laredo.
documents_needed: Social Security numbers for household members
Valid email and phone number (for online application)
records.how_to_apply: Use the 'Apply for Assistance' button on the LHA website, or call the office.
records.how_to_apply_es: Use el botón 'Apply for Assistance' en la página web de LHA, o llame a la oficina.
records.notes: LHA manages 994 public housing units in 8 locations. Phone from HUD's PHA contact list (PHA code TX011); not shown on the LHA home page. The online application asks for a valid email, Social Security numbers for household members, a working phone number, and household income information.

records.name: Housing Choice Voucher (Section 8) - Laredo Housing Authority
records.organization: Housing Authority of the City of Laredo
records.description_en: A voucher that helps pay rent for a home you choose from a private landlord.
records.description_es: Un vale que ayuda a pagar la renta de una casa que usted elige con un dueño privado.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For low-income families. LHA's voucher program serves Laredo, Zapata and Asherton.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Para familias de bajos ingresos. El programa de vales de LHA atiende Laredo, Zapata y Asherton.
documents_needed: Social Security numbers for household members
Valid email and phone number (for online application)
records.how_to_apply: Check the LHA website for when the waiting list is open and apply with the 'Apply for Assistance' button.
records.how_to_apply_es: Revise en la página web de LHA cuándo está abierta la lista de espera y haga su solicitud con el botón 'Apply for Assistance'.
records.notes: LHA site announced the HCV waiting list would open May 1, 2026; it may have closed since, so check before referring. About 1,390 families served in Laredo, Zapata and Asherton. Phone from HUD's PHA contact list (TX011).

records.name: Del Rio Housing Authority
records.description_en: The local public housing agency for Del Rio. It offers affordable rental housing for low-income people.
records.description_es: La agencia local de vivienda pública de Del Rio. Ofrece vivienda de renta económica para personas de bajos ingresos.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For low-income families, seniors and people with disabilities in Del Rio.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Para familias de bajos ingresos, personas mayores y personas con discapacidad en Del Rio.
records.how_to_apply: Call the housing authority to ask about applying and wait list status.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llame a la autoridad de vivienda para preguntar cómo solicitar y si la lista de espera está abierta.
records.notes: Confirmed on HUD's official PHA contact list (PHA code TX016); phone ext. 104. Program types (public housing vs. vouchers) not confirmed. Email listed by HUD: drhousing@gmail.com.

records.name: Eagle Pass Housing Authority
records.description_en: The local public housing agency for Eagle Pass. It offers affordable rental housing for low-income people.
records.description_es: La agencia local de vivienda pública de Eagle Pass. Ofrece vivienda de renta económica para personas de bajos ingresos.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For low-income families, seniors and people with disabilities in Eagle Pass.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Para familias de bajos ingresos, personas mayores y personas con discapacidad en Eagle Pass.
records.how_to_apply: Call the housing authority to ask about applying and wait list status.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llame a la autoridad de vivienda para preguntar cómo solicitar y si la lista de espera está abierta.
records.notes: Confirmed on HUD's official PHA contact list (PHA code TX019). The authority's own website did not show program details. Program types not confirmed.

records.name: Workforce Solutions for South Texas - Job Seeker Services
records.description_en: Free help finding a job, job training, help with unemployment benefits, and services for veterans, young adults and people with disabilities.
records.description_es: Ayuda gratis para buscar trabajo, capacitación, ayuda con los beneficios de desempleo, y servicios para veteranos, jóvenes y personas con discapacidad.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For job seekers in Webb, Zapata and Jim Hogg counties.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Para personas que buscan trabajo en los condados de Webb, Zapata y Jim Hogg.
records.how_to_apply: Visit or call a Workforce Solutions office, or search jobs on WorkInTexas.com.
records.how_to_apply_es: Visite o llame a una oficina de Workforce Solutions, o busque trabajos en WorkInTexas.com.
records.notes: Zapata office: 605 U.S. Hwy 83, Suite B, Zapata, TX 78076, (956) 765-1804 (job seekers page; home page lists (956) 794-6500 for both). Also has virtual stations at 14+ libraries and city halls. Offers RESEA help for people on unemployment.

records.name: Child Care Services (CCS)
records.description_en: Helps low-income families pay for child care while parents work, go to school, or attend training.
records.description_es: Ayuda a familias de bajos ingresos a pagar la guardería mientras los padres trabajan, estudian o toman una capacitación.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For low-income families with children ages 0-13 whose parents are working, in training, or in school.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Para familias de bajos ingresos con niños de 0 a 13 años cuyos padres trabajan, estudian o están en capacitación.
records.how_to_apply: Call or text the Child Care Services intake team, or email ccs@southtexasworkforce.org.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llame o mande un mensaje de texto al equipo de Servicios de Cuidado Infantil, o escriba a ccs@southtexasworkforce.org.
records.notes: Text line: (956) 634-7851. Income limits not posted; ask intake. Zapata office: 605 US Hwy 83, Suite B, Zapata, TX 78076. max_age reflects children ages 0-13.

records.name: Workforce Solutions Middle Rio Grande
records.description_en: Helps people find jobs and get training. It also helps eligible working families pay for child care.
records.description_es: Ayuda a las personas a encontrar trabajo y recibir capacitación. También ayuda a familias trabajadoras que califican a pagar la guardería.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For job seekers and working families in Maverick, Val Verde and other Middle Rio Grande counties.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Para personas que buscan trabajo y familias trabajadoras en Maverick, Val Verde y otros condados del Middle Rio Grande.
records.how_to_apply: Call the customer line or email customer.referral@wfsmrg.org.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llame a la línea de atención al cliente o escriba a customer.referral@wfsmrg.org.
records.notes: Also serves Edwards, Dimmit, Kinney, La Salle, Real, Uvalde and Zavala. Eagle Pass and Del Rio office addresses were not listed on the page reached; call for the nearest center.

records.name: Border Region Behavioral Health Center
records.description_en: The local mental health authority for Laredo and Zapata. It offers mental health care and a 24-hour crisis line.
records.description_es: La autoridad local de salud mental para Laredo y Zapata. Ofrece atención de salud mental y una línea de crisis las 24 horas.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For people with mental health or behavioral health needs in Webb and Zapata counties.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Para personas con necesidades de salud mental o del comportamiento en los condados de Webb y Zapata.
records.how_to_apply: Call the main number to ask about services. In a crisis, call the 24-hour crisis hotline.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llame al número principal para preguntar por los servicios. En una crisis, llame a la línea de crisis de 24 horas.
records.notes: 24-Hour Crisis Hotline: 1-800-643-1102. Toll-free main: 1-833-463-0258. Also serves Jim Hogg and Starr. YES Waiver: (844) 503-6182. First Episode Psychosis: (956) 794-3178.

records.name: Camino Real Community Services
records.description_en: The local mental health and IDD authority for Maverick County and nearby counties. It has a 24-hour crisis hotline.
records.description_es: La autoridad local de salud mental y de discapacidades intelectuales y del desarrollo para el condado de Maverick y condados cercanos. Tiene una línea de crisis las 24 horas.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For people with mental health or intellectual and developmental disability needs in Maverick and nearby counties.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Para personas con necesidades de salud mental o con discapacidades intelectuales y del desarrollo en Maverick y condados cercanos.
records.how_to_apply: Call the main office or toll-free number to ask about services. In a crisis, call the 24-hour hotline.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llame a la oficina principal o al número gratuito para preguntar por los servicios. En una crisis, llame a la línea de 24 horas.
records.notes: 24/7 Crisis Hotline: 1-800-543-5750. Main office (210) 357-0300 is in Lytle; Eagle Pass clinic address not listed on the page. Also serves Atascosa, Dimmit, Frio, Karnes, La Salle, McMullen, Wilson, Zavala.

records.name: Hill Country Mental Health & Developmental Disabilities Centers
records.description_en: The local mental health and developmental disability authority that serves Val Verde County. It has a 24-hour crisis hotline.
records.description_es: La autoridad local de salud mental y discapacidades del desarrollo que atiende el condado de Val Verde. Tiene una línea de crisis las 24 horas.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For people with mental health, substance use, or developmental disability needs in Val Verde and other Hill Country counties.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Para personas con necesidades de salud mental, uso de sustancias o discapacidades del desarrollo en Val Verde y otros condados del Hill Country.
records.how_to_apply: Call the main number to ask about services near Del Rio. In a crisis, call the crisis hotline.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llame al número principal para preguntar por servicios cerca de Del Rio. En una crisis, llame a la línea de crisis.
records.notes: Crisis Hotline: 1-877-466-0660. Toll-free: (833) 426-4332. Del Rio clinic address not listed on the page reached. Main office is in Kerrville.

records.name: Gateway Community Health Center
records.description_en: A community health center with doctors, children's care, women's health, dental, behavioral health and a pharmacy. It offers a sliding fee discount based on income.
records.description_es: Un centro de salud comunitario con doctores, atención para niños, salud de la mujer, dentista, salud mental y farmacia. Ofrece descuentos según sus ingresos.
records.eligibility_summary_en: Open to everyone. People with income at or below 200% of the federal poverty level can get a sliding fee discount.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Abierto para todos. Las personas con ingresos iguales o menores al 200% del nivel federal de pobreza pueden recibir un descuento según sus ingresos.
documents_needed: Proof of income (for sliding fee discount)
records.how_to_apply: Call registration and eligibility to make an appointment and ask about the sliding fee discount.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llame a registro y elegibilidad para hacer una cita y preguntar por el descuento según ingresos.
records.notes: Clinics: Laredo Central 1515 Pappas St; North 208 Shiloh Dr Ste 1; South 2007 S. Zapata Hwy; West 1702 Lafayette St; 6801 McPherson Rd Ste 336; 7210 McPherson Rd Ste 108 (all Laredo); Zapata 210 N. Rathmell Ave, Zapata 78076; Hebbronville 473 State Hwy 285. After-hours line (956) 795-8100. The 200% FPL limit is for the sliding fee discount, not for being seen.

records.name: Texas RioGrande Legal Aid (Laredo, Eagle Pass, Del Rio offices)
records.description_en: Free civil legal help for low-income people, including housing, public benefits, family law, employment and disaster cases.
records.description_es: Ayuda legal civil gratis para personas de bajos ingresos, en temas de vivienda, beneficios públicos, derecho familiar, empleo y desastres.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For low-income people in TRLA's service area. Call intake to see if you qualify.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Para personas de bajos ingresos en el área que atiende TRLA. Llame a la línea de admisión para saber si califica.
records.how_to_apply: Call the intake line weekdays 9 a.m. to 5 p.m. For family law, call on Tuesdays and Thursdays only.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llame a la línea de admisión de lunes a viernes de 9 a.m. a 5 p.m. Para casos de derecho familiar, llame solo los martes y jueves.
records.notes: Toll-free intake: (833) 329-8752. Eagle Pass office: 466 Jefferson Street, Suite A, Eagle Pass, TX 78852. Del Rio office: 902 E. 11th St., Del Rio, TX 78840. Zapata County coverage not confirmed this session (check TRLA service-area map).

records.name: El Metro Reduced Fare Program
records.description_en: Seniors 62 and older and people with disabilities can ride Laredo city buses for $0.75 at peak times and $0.25 at off-peak times.
records.description_es: Las personas de 62 años o más y las personas con discapacidad pueden viajar en los autobuses de Laredo por $0.75 en horas pico y $0.25 en horas normales.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For people age 62 and older and people with a qualifying disability. Medicare cardholders qualify without filling out the application.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Para personas de 62 años o más y personas con una discapacidad que califica. Quienes tienen tarjeta de Medicare califican sin llenar la solicitud.
documents_needed: Reduced Fare Program application with certification form (if applying by age or disability)
Medicare card (Medicare cardholders do not need the application)
records.how_to_apply: Fill out the Reduced Fare Program application (Medicare cardholders can skip it) and get an El Metro reduced fare photo ID. The ID costs $2.00 and is renewed every two years. Call or visit El Metro Customer Service at the Laredo Transit Center.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llene la solicitud del Programa de Tarifa Reducida (con tarjeta de Medicare no necesita llenarla) y saque la identificación con foto de tarifa reducida de El Metro. La identificación cuesta $2.00 y se renueva cada dos años. Llame o visite Servicio al Cliente de El Metro en el Centro de Tránsito de Laredo.
records.cost: $2.00 ID fee; reduced fares $0.75 peak / $0.25 off-peak
records.notes: Peak = Mon-Fri 6-9am and 3-6pm; off-peak = Mon-Fri 9am-3pm and 6-10pm. Phone is El Metro Customer Service (contact page), 1301 Farragut lobby. A separate Drug Rehabilitation Reduced Fare application also exists.

records.name: El Lift Paratransit
records.description_en: Shared-ride, curb-to-curb van service in Laredo for people whose disability keeps them from using the regular bus. Rides cost $1.75 to $2.25 based on distance.
records.description_es: Servicio de camioneta compartida, de acera a acera, en Laredo para personas que por su discapacidad no pueden usar el autobús regular. Los viajes cuestan de $1.75 a $2.25 según la distancia.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For people with disabilities who cannot use fixed-route buses because of their disability (ADA paratransit eligibility).
records.eligibility_summary_es: Para personas con discapacidad que no pueden usar los autobuses de ruta fija por su discapacidad (elegibilidad de paratránsito ADA).
records.how_to_apply: Download the application, have your doctor verify it, then fax it to (956) 795-2317 or email it to El Metro.
records.how_to_apply_es: Descargue la solicitud, pida a su doctor que confirme su discapacidad en ella, y luego envíela por fax al (956) 795-2317 o por correo electrónico a El Metro.
records.hours: Mon-Fri 5:00 AM - 10:00 PM; Sat 6:00 AM - 10:00 PM; Sun 7:30 AM - 7:30 PM (temporary revised hours)
records.cost: $1.75 up to 7 miles; $2.00 for 7.1-14 miles; $2.25 for 14.1+ miles
records.notes: Personal care attendants ride free. Exact fare required when boarding; 10-ride ticket booklets $17.50-$22.50. Tickets sold at the Laredo Transit Center, 1301 Farragut St. Application email: sesparza@ci.laredo.tx.us. El Metro's contact page lists the El Lift office at 401 Scott.

records.name: Zapata County Indigent Health Care Program
records.description_en: Helps low-income Zapata County residents pay for doctor visits, hospital care, lab tests, X-rays and up to three prescriptions a month.
records.description_es: Ayuda a residentes de bajos ingresos del condado de Zapata a pagar consultas médicas, hospital, análisis de laboratorio, rayos X y hasta tres medicinas al mes.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For low-income Zapata County residents who do not qualify for other state or federal health programs.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Para residentes de bajos ingresos del condado de Zapata que no califican para otros programas de salud estatales o federales.
records.how_to_apply: Call or visit the Indigent Program office to apply.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llame o visite la oficina del Programa de Indigentes para hacer su solicitud.
records.notes: Medical care is given through Zapata Family Medical Center (affiliated with Laredo Medical Center); office is at the Zapata County Medical Clinic. Covers immunizations, screenings, physicals, hospital and doctor services, X-rays/CT/MRI, and up to 3 prescriptions a month. Income limits and documents not posted; call. Email: patglz@zapatacountytx.org. County main line: (956) 765-9920.

records.name: Zapata County Nutrition Center
records.description_en: Serves free lunches at noon on weekdays for seniors at sites in Zapata, San Ygnacio and Falcon. It also offers home-delivered meals and rides for seniors who qualify.
records.description_es: Sirve almuerzos gratis al mediodía, de lunes a viernes, para personas mayores en Zapata, San Ygnacio y Falcón. También lleva comidas a casa y da transporte a personas mayores que califican.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For Zapata County residents age 60 and older.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Para residentes del condado de Zapata de 60 años o más.
records.how_to_apply: Call the office or stop by to fill out an application.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llame a la oficina o pase a llenar una solicitud.
records.notes: Alternate phone: (956) 765-3185. Mailing address: P.O. Box 489, Zapata, TX 78076. Senior rides: to Laredo Tue/Thu for medical appointments, Rio Grande City and San Juan monthly, local trips Mon-Fri; suggested donations $1.50-$7.00.

records.name: Zapata Express Bus Service to Laredo
records.description_en: A county bus service that runs between Zapata and Laredo on weekdays.
records.description_es: Un servicio de autobús del condado que viaja entre Zapata y Laredo de lunes a viernes.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For Zapata County residents who need a ride to Laredo.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Para residentes del condado de Zapata que necesitan transporte a Laredo.
records.how_to_apply: Call Zapata County to ask about the schedule and fare.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llame al condado de Zapata para preguntar por el horario y el precio.
records.notes: Listed on the Zapata County home page with the main county phone number. Schedule, stops and fare not confirmed; the dedicated transit page could not be loaded.

records.name: United Way of Laredo
records.description_en: Funds local agencies that help with food, shelter and health. It also runs a VITA program for free tax help.
records.description_es: Da fondos a agencias locales que ayudan con comida, albergue y salud. También tiene el programa VITA para preparar impuestos gratis.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For Laredo residents who need help finding services or free tax preparation.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Para residentes de Laredo que necesitan ayuda para encontrar servicios o preparar sus impuestos gratis.
records.how_to_apply: Call United Way of Laredo to ask about partner agencies or the VITA free tax program.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llame a United Way of Laredo para preguntar por sus agencias asociadas o por el programa VITA de impuestos gratis.
records.notes: United Way mainly funds partner agencies (e.g., Bethany House of Laredo, Casa de Misericordia, Boys & Girls Club) rather than giving direct cash help. VITA free tax help is seasonal. Categories reflect partner-agency referrals.
